BASIS - Senior Consultant

 

🌟 NTT DATA Business Solutions – Walk-In Drive | Bangalore | 22 Aug 2026 🌟
We’re hiring skilled professionals for the following roles:

💼 Open Positions:
• SAP BASIS (6 –12 yrs)
• Linux Administrator / Server Management (5 – 8 yrs)

If you possess strong SAP BASIS, & Linux- Server Management Admin expertise and are seeking impactful opportunities within a global technology leader, we would love to meet you.

🗓️ Date: 22 Aug 2026
⏰ Time: 9:00 AM
📝 Mode: Direct Walk-In
📄 Bring: Resume (hard copy) + Govt ID

📍 Venue: NTT DATA Business Solutions Pvt. Ltd.,
S.J.R. I Park, Tower 2 (PHI Tower), EPIP Zone 1, Whitefield, Bengaluru – 560066

🫵 How to Apply:
🖊️ 1. Fill in the application form for the Walk-In Drive.
https://lnkd.in/dbCCU4SE

🖊️ 2. Our HR team will review your profile and share an invitation to join the Walk-In drive.

🧰 Don’t miss this opportunity to become part of a dynamic, innovative, and growing SAP team.
